# 📊 Test Execution Report

## Summary
Build/branch, commit SHA, tester, date, environment and overall result.

## Execution
| Suite/case | Command or steps | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|

## Environment
Node/npm, browser, OS, viewport and assistive technology versions.

## Failures
Record reproduction steps, expected/actual result, severity, board fixture and linked issue.

## Coverage and gaps
Describe tested behaviors, skipped tests and unavailable environments. Do not invent percentages.

## Release recommendation
Approve / Reject / Conditional, residual risks, owners and sign-off.
